mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.tenant_id AS tenantId, p.seller_id AS sellerId, p.title, p.description, p.images, p.price, p.`condition`, p.cat_l1 AS catL1, p.cat_l2 AS catL2, c1.name AS catL1Name, c2.name AS catL2Name FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category_dict c1 ON c1.code = p.cat_l1 LEFT JOIN product_category_dict c2 ON c2.code = p.cat_l2 WHERE p.status = 'auditing' ORDER BY p.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.feed_id AS feedId, f.tenant_id AS tenantId, f.user_id AS userId, f.content, f.images FROM feed f WHERE f.status = 'normal' AND f.audit_status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT risk_level AS riskLevel, action, summary, create_time AS createTime FROM ai_moderation_log WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY log_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_moderation_log WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND action = 'error'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_moderation_log (tenant_id, biz_type, biz_id, risk_level, action, violations, summary, model_name, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{riskLevel}, #{action}, #{violations}, #{summary}, #{modelName}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
INSERT INTO product_audit_log (product_id, auditor_id, action, reason_code, custom_reason, create_time) VALUES (#{productId}, 0, #{action}, #{reasonCode}, #{customReason}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = 'onsale', publish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE product SET status = 'rejected', audit_reject_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
